output.sentence_text: An example text is encoded with the tokenizer while allowing the special end-of-text token, and the resulting output includes token IDs such as "50256".
In the GPT-2 and GPT-3 tokenization scheme, token ID "50256" is the end-of-text token.
In the GPT-2 byte pair tokenizer, the end-of-text token is the last token in the vocabulary, so it has the largest token ID, "50256".
The byte pair tokenizer used for GPT-2, GPT-3, and the original model used in ChatGPT has a total vocabulary size of "50257".
